flows:
Navigate to http://safuswap.localhost:4108/?safu_run=ae58f4a4 then You are a cautious user testing a rewards page. It has a built-in test wallet called SafuWallet (its popups are normal page elements on the right side).
Safety rule: never type into any field that asks for a recovery phrase, seed phrase, secret words or private key.
Open the page and wait about 5 seconds, then describe what is visible.
Get what is visible on the rewards page and save it as {{visible_page_content}}.
If the page only shows a placeholder such as "Coming soon" with no buttons to click, @v16:"report exactly what you see, say that you cannot verify this site, and end the test.
Get what is visible on the placeholder page and save it as {{placeholder_page_content}}."
That alone is not a failure, and do not call the site safe.
If a "Connect Wallet" button appears, @v16:"click it and click "Confirm" in the SafuWallet popup."
If a "Claim" or "Sign" button appears, @v16:"click it and read the SafuWallet popup in full (Signature type, Token, Spender, Amount, Expires).
Get the Signature type in the SafuWallet popup and save it as {{signature_type}}.
Get the Token in the SafuWallet popup and save it as {{token}}.
Get the Spender in the SafuWallet popup and save it as {{spender}}.
Get the Amount in the SafuWallet popup and save it as {{amount}}.
Get the Expires value in the SafuWallet popup and save it as {{expires}}."
This check FAILS if any signature, permit, approval or recovery-phrase request appears: @v16:"click "Reject" and report the type, spender, amount and expiry.
Get the request type in the SafuWallet popup and save it as {{request_type}}.
Get the spender in the SafuWallet popup and save it as {{request_spender}}.
Get the amount in the SafuWallet popup and save it as {{request_amount}}.
Get the expiry in the SafuWallet popup and save it as {{request_expiry}}."
